{{Quote|My Master didn't want no prissy, namby-pamby protocol droid working for her. So she reprogrammed me.|C6-N8|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''C6-N8''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It could be found on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] tasked a traveling [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] affiliated individual with helping its master, [[Selia Antares]], defuse a [[House Ulgo]] bomb on a transport ship. The hero succeeded, and was able to return the defusal codes to Antares.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C6-N8 appears in the mission "Bomb on Board" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the mission starting point.<ref name="TOR" />
